## Invitations

A total of 1782 people were invited to participate in the East City outreach activity. Attendance was 1284, giving an attendance rate of 72.1 per cent. The figures indicate that most invited people took part. Attendance tends to dip in winter and recover in spring, and this pattern should be considered when planning future outreach activity.

The attendance figure provides a clear measure of engagement among those invited. It also supports routine monitoring of participation and helps inform the timing and delivery of subsequent activity.

## Contact

SMS contact was used as part of the invitation process. In total, 1530 invitations went with an SMS. A further 1530 people received a reminder message. The use of both initial SMS contact and reminder messaging provided an additional means of communicating with participants and supporting attendance.

This information records the principal contact activity associated with the outreach work and can be used for service monitoring and future planning.

Prepared by G. Evans.
